name: YT MP3 Queue
description: Send YouTube videos and playlists to your MP3 downloader's queue without leaving YouTube.
_comment_key: This 'key' field pins the extension's ID to chrome-extension://lfcekljajioeijjmcaandpbdlgddlmda regardless of which folder it's loaded from (see extension/README.md). It is the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of a keypair generated for this dev build (extension/gen_key.js); the matching private key is NOT committed. The backend's CORS allowlist (app/main.py) trusts exactly this origin -- if this key ever changes, the backend must be updated to match, or every request from the extension will be rejected by CORS.
